name: fill-marks-dirty
title: Fix fill marks bytes dirty when fill value matches existing byte
description: Fill Selection registers an unsaved edit for every byte in the selected range, even when the fill value equals the byte's current value. buildFillTransaction() pushes prev entry and sets S.edits unconditionally; should mirror stageIntegrityEdit() semantics: revert-if-equal-original, skip-if-no-change.
creator: deviousprophet
